note: Declared ordering policy for the takeable-work projection over soveraeign-ticket/v1 instances. The queue is a projection and is rebuildable from the tickets alone; it introduces no standing, priority authority, or private state. Changing the order changes what work is offered first, so the policy is declared data rather than code.
kinds_outside_dispatch_note: A story is told by an actor in a role and walked through a scenario; it is never taken as work, so it never enters the takeable queue and never blocks or unblocks anything in it. Its asks point at the stubs and bits that are.

next_action.DEMOTED: repair against the defeating observation and re-enter at PROPOSED
next_action.BUILT_SELF_TESTED_NOT_WITNESSED: continue reachable work toward the declared target; when a named milestone consumes independent witness, take its verification-engagement rather than treating unwitnessed standing as a global block
next_action.CHARTERED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: build the smallest change that satisfies the visible case
next_action.DECLARED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: write the charter and the machine-checkable contract
next_action.PROPOSED: declare the owned boundary in the repository
next_action.OPEN: draft the obligation, priors, and closure contract
next_action.WITNESSED: present it for acceptance: python scripts/sov_accept.py present <packet>
next_action.RATIFIED: no further action at this gate

unblock_note: An unblock request is takeable work: it is served by the tier it names in requested_from, and it sorts up because the ticket it holds counts toward unblocks. Blocked is never a ticket status; it is a held-by edge to an unblock ticket (AGENTS.md, Blocked edge is not blocked frontier).
witness_note: BUILT is a valid continuing engineering standing, not an instruction to stop. Blue remains continuous inside the work unit. Independent Red work is queued as verification-engagement at a named milestone. Once queued, verification-engagement remains high-ranked because it gates the milestone that asked for it; before that boundary exists, outstanding witness standing alone does not make the concern blocked.
provision_routes_note: Which tiers may serve each provision. Declared data, not authority: serving a grant or judgement still needs the live grant the kernel checks at the transition.
acceptance_note: WITNESSED is not a waiting room. A witnessed claim is written up as an acceptance packet and presented to the seat one edge up; nothing sits on an owner without a packet (contracts/acceptance-policy.json).
kind_rank_note: Every dispatchable kind is ranked. An unranked kind falls back to 99 and sorts below everything without saying so, which is what happened to verification-engagement between decisions 0018 and 0066: a Red engagement gates a named milestone and was sorting last. The rank is only a tiebreaker - blocked, horizon, what a ticket unblocks, and standing all sort first - so it says what to prefer between equally urgent tickets, not what matters most. A chore sorts last on that tiebreak because it maintains a surface rather than advancing one.
